building_identity: Delta Tau Delta, Gamma Lambda Chapter, 400 Northwestern Avenue, West Lafayette, Indiana

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office; footprint data credited to Polis Center at IUPUI
sources.title: Indiana Statewide LiDAR Derived Building Footprints / Indiana Building Footprints 2016-2020
sources.source_date: LidarYear field is 2018; metadata publication date 2022-08-08; service snapshot retrieved 2026-10-26
sources.source_crs: Service native spatial reference EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100); query requested outSR=4326 (WGS 84)
sources.measurement_method: Used the returned building polygon and transformed each vertex to the project's documented local approximation (X=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274 degrees), Y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040).
sources.uncertainty: Dataset does not name the structure; metadata says polygons are automated derivatives of 2016-2020 USGS 3DEP LiDAR, are reference data rather than a legal survey, and may differ from detailed on-the-ground/historical review. Identity match is supported by parcel/address/location context and the close match to the existing asset envelope. The polygon may not represent later small additions or decorative projections.

sources.title: 400 Northwestern Avenue address candidate
sources.measurement_method: Returned address point: longitude -86.910279617946, latitude 40.428042917547. Spatially queried the 2018 footprint service at the point and at the adjacent building center; the address point itself falls just outside the footprint, consistent with an address point on the frontage.
sources.uncertainty: Address geocoding identifies the parcel/frontage, not a surveyed building entrance or wall corner.

sources.title: Z-2826, Purdue Delta Tau Delta Association, Inc., staff report
sources.measurement_method: Document text identifies the address as 400 Northwestern Avenue and states that the building was constructed in 1928, reflects Tudor Revival characteristics, and has been home to a fraternity for several decades.
sources.uncertainty: The staff report characterizes architectural style and age but provides no dimensioned plan, facade elevations, floor count, or measured height.

sources.provider: Delta Tau Delta, The Rainbow, Vol. 94, No. 1
sources.title: 1970 Fall issue, Purdue Shelter addition
sources.feature_id: Purdue Gamma Lambda Shelter; 400 Northwestern Avenue
sources.source_date: 1970 (Fall issue; article describes the addition dedication in May 1970)
sources.measurement_method: The article/caption describes the Woodson C. Immel addition as approximately doubling the Shelter, locates it at 400 Northwestern Avenue, and says the original building was erected in 1928.
sources.uncertainty: The prose establishes an addition and relative size only. The local geometry and exact junction between original and addition are not identified in a plan.

sources.provider: Indiana Historical Society, Hugh J. Baker & Company Collection finding aid
sources.title: Hugh J. Baker & Company Collection, 1905-1972, Box 9, Folder 31
sources.feature_id: Box 9, Folder 31, Delta Tau Delta Fraternity, 400 Northwestern Ave.
sources.source_date: 1928 project record listed in finding aid
sources.measurement_method: Finding-aid entry identifies architect Bishop, Knowlton & Carson (Indianapolis), contractor Hall Construction Co. (Indianapolis), date 1928, and related photographs.
sources.uncertainty: Finding aid identifies associated project records but the plans/photographs were not directly inspected for this model.

sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
sources.title: J. C. Allen negatives and photographs inventory, entries 25.7.107-25.7.112
sources.feature_id: Items 25.7.107-25.7.112; fraternity exterior groups and 1946 construction photographs
sources.measurement_method: Inventory identifies several groups photographed outside the Delta Tau Delta house and five 1946 construction photographs and a negative.
sources.uncertainty: Inventory metadata confirms that visual records exist; the images themselves were not accessible/inspected for this model and were not used to infer dimensions.

sources.provider: Purdue Delts / Gamma Lambda house corporation
sources.title: Purdue Delts chapter site
sources.measurement_method: Site labels the organization as Purdue Delts and displays '400 Northwestern' as the chapter's online gathering place.
sources.uncertainty: The current landing page provides identity/address but no architectural measurements or facade documentation.

sources.provider: Purdue Delts account, X profile image
sources.title: Delta Tau Delta Gamma Lambda Chapter house profile image
sources.measurement_method: Inspected the account's 400x400 profile photograph. It visibly shows the red-brick chapter house with several steep, front-facing gables, rows of rectangular windows, a tall chimney, and a masonry arched entrance. The view is used to guide only those broad visible forms; no lengths, floor count, roof pitch, or exact dimensions were measured.
sources.uncertainty: The low-resolution image is a snowy, partial oblique view. Snow obscures roofing and wall details; the full facade, floor count, addition seam, and exact number/size of architectural elements remain unverified.
